Official Product Matrix • Community == 100% Architect Parity

Editions, Feature Matrix & RaggieScript

RaggieSoft Installer Studio is organized into four clear editions—Community, Essentials, Developer, and Architect—built around two permanent commitments: Community Edition maintains 100% technical feature parity with Architect Edition for hobbyists, solo creators, educators, and open-source maintainers, and runtime WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility and Authenticode signing are never paywalled in any commercial tier.

Commercial licensing opens alongside v1.0.0 GA; during active Technical Preview, our signed universal v0.5.0 installer is free to download and evaluate with full Architect parity unlocked.

Signed Binary Notice • Why Windows SmartScreen Still Prompts Temporarily

100% Cryptographically Signed: Every official RaggieSoft Studio download—including Universal Web & Offline Setup.exe launchers, inner x64 & ARM64 .msi databases, Installer Studio v0.5.0, and Accessibility Studio v1.0.0—is Dual-Layer Authenticode-signed via Microsoft Azure Artifact Signing (Verified publisher: Michael Ragsdale, RFC 3161 timestamped, and verified with signtool verify /pa).

Why SmartScreen may still say “Windows protected your PC” right now: Our Microsoft Public Trust signing certificate is brand-new (issued November 25, 2026). Under Microsoft’s current SmartScreen rules, newly issued certificates start at zero download reputation until initial install volume and Microsoft Security Intelligence (WDSI) review complete (already submitted). To install safely while reputation clears: click More info, confirm Windows shows Publisher: Michael Ragsdale (never “Unknown publisher”), and click Run anyway. Full details in the FAQ →

Everything in Essentials plus compiling new .MSM Merge Modules, RaggieScript (.rssc) zero-MSI native scripting & Engine = native, From-Scratch C++ & MSI.DLL Dialog Designers, VS/VB6 importers, msiprism.exe, RsUpdate.exe, and commercial CI/CD runners.

Everything in Developer plus Multi-Product Unified .rsis Suites (Showcase Studio front-door + dynamic ARPSYSTEMCOMPONENT), .MSP binary-delta patches & .MST transforms, Disk Spanning / msiexec /a, .rswpak CDN packs, and Automated HTML5 VPAT 2.5.

Key Licensing & Technical Design Choices

How Essentials, Standalone Self-Extractor & Upgrades Work

1. Why Community Edition Equals Architect Edition

Independent hobbyists, students, educators, and open-source maintainers deserve industrial-grade packaging tools without crippled dialogs or nag banners. Community Edition unlocks 100% of Architect Edition—from RaggieScript to .rsis Suites and VPAT 2.5—while keeping compiled VERSIONINFO and wizard chrome 100% publisher-owned.

2. .MSM Consumption & Major Upgrades in Essentials

Essentials Edition consumes existing 32-bit and 64-bit .MSM Merge Modules ([MergeModule.*]) so teams can bundle vendor redistributables cleanly, while reserving new .MSM creation for Developer+. Shipping 1.0.0 → 1.0.1 in Essentials performs an atomic MSI.DLL Major Upgrade (minting a fresh ProductCode under your permanent UpgradeCode) without .MSP patch overhead.

3. Standalone Folder / .ZIP Self-Extractor Tool

In addition to PackageKind = sfx inside the main IDE, our lightweight Self-Extractor will also ship as a dedicated standalone utility—compressing any folder or .zip into an LZMS single-file .exe with selectable UAC level, Dark/Light/Contrast UI, and a Software Installation %TEMP% wrapper that automatically waits for child process trees and classic cleanup helpers like _ISDEL.EXE before scrubbing %TEMP%!

4. Suite-Wide Editions, RaggieScript Everywhere & Dual-Bar Suites

All 8 RaggieSoft Studio products (plus All-Access Studio Suite bundles, including free RaggieSoft Studio Community) share the exact same Community, Essentials, Developer, and Architect tiers—with RaggieScript (.rssc) spanning all 8 tools via host-specific subsets and Unified Suite Setups rendering monotonic Overall + Current Component dual progress bars!

Coming in v0.7.0 • Community, Developer & Architect Editions

Preview: RaggieScript (.rssc) Zero-MSI Native Scripting Engine

When you want full programmatic control with zero msi.dll dependency and zero Global_MSIExecute mutex contention, RaggieScript (.rssc) compiles clean C# / TypeScript-style curly-brace scripts directly into compact RSWBC1 bytecode (< 50 KB static /MT C++20 VM with /DELAYLOAD:msi.dll)—supporting both 100% standalone setup.rssc projects and hybrid .rsip + ScriptFile = setup.rssc workflows.

  • Compile-Time Phase Isolation: wizard { ... } is strictly side-effect-free UI and pre-flight probing with an automatic ← Back navigation state stack (calling mutating operations inside wizard is caught at compile time via RSW701).
  • Automatic Double-Entry Rollback & Uninstaller Ledger: Every mutating statement in install { ... } (fs.extract, reg.writeString, shortcut.create, env.appendPath) automatically writes its inverse undo entry to .rsw-rollback.jnl for instant mid-install cancellation rollback and records clean removal metadata for signed native Uninstall.exe.
// Standalone RaggieScript (.rssc) project — compiles via: instbuild.exe setup.rssc --arch=x64
package "Sample Studio Workbench" {
  id:        "{9B4E20A1-7C93-4D62-9B44-524147474950}";
  version:   1.2.0;
  publisher: "Sample Studio";
  scope:     Scope.Machine;
  uac:       Uac.AsInvoker;
  style:     WizardStyle.AeroWizard;
}

param installDir: path   = sys.programFiles / "Sample Studio" / "Workbench";
param serverUrl:  string = "https://raggiesoftstudio.com";

payload CoreFiles { from "..\publish\win-${arch}\*" -> installDir; }

wizard {
  step Welcome     { ui.welcome("Welcome to Sample Studio Workbench"); }
  step Destination { ui.folderPicker(label: "Install &location:", bind: ref installDir); }
  step Endpoint when (!sys.isSilent) {
    ui.textBox(label: "&Server URL:", bind: ref serverUrl);
  }
  step Ready       { ui.readySummary(installButton: "&Install"); }
}

install {
  fs.extract(CoreFiles);
  reg.writeString(Hive.HKLM, "Software\SampleStudio\Workbench", "Endpoint", serverUrl);
  shortcut.create(ShortcutLocation.StartMenu, "Sample Studio Workbench", installDir / "Workbench.exe");
}
